recommendation: Keep the empty audit commit. Any future desire to make the summary table say alternate concept instead of alternate codings should be handled as separate editorial cleanup, not as a missing application of FHIR-17284.
issue_request: FHIR-17284 was Published/Persuasive with Modification for STU3 and requested replacing alternate system.code wording in the Extensible binding definition with wording that permits an alternate concept, either a system/code pair or text, when the value set does not cover the concept.
initial_application: Commit 03f12f1f1f6c71c7577c76d70181641baae7dac0 applied the Jira-requested wording in source/terminologies.html. Commit 5f9b6eca5d50330629f2377af855a6e043ba8146 then folded the rule into the same-day FHIR-14865 Extensible hierarchy clarification without reverting the alternate concept semantics.
additional_context: The current source/terminologies.html detailed Extensible section says that if there is no applicable concept in the value set, an alternate concept, including system/code, system/version/code, or text, may be used. Later FHIR-29968 and its existing combined-branch reconciliation aligned the broader Extensible usage notes and the formal binding-strength CodeSystem definition. FHIR-48479 added a current summary table whose codings/text wording is compatible and links to the detailed section.
reconciliation: No source change was made because the rejected system.code-only language is absent, the detailed build-scope terminology narrative states the accepted alternate concept/text rule, and the formal binding-strength CodeSystem has already been aligned through FHIR-29968.
